display.purpose: Large page titles; the gift page applies responsive sizing.

body.purpose: The shared cursive stack inherited by page copy and controls.

motion.name: gift-button-state
motion.value: color 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out

components.name: Site navigation link
components.description: Centered, wrapping site navigation link with an inverse hover and focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-site-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; } .ds-site-nav a { display: inline-block; min-width: 7rem; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; background-color: #ac2222; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-site-nav a:hover, .ds-site-nav a:focus-visible { color: #2c3e50; background-color: #e0e0e0; }

components.name: Gift button
components.description: Primary gift-page action; hover inverts its colors and lifts slightly.
components.css: .ds-gift-button { min-height: 3.1rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; color: #ffffff; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #ac2222; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-gift-button:hover:not(:disabled) { color: #2c3e50; background: #ffffff; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-gift-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2c3e50; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-gift-button:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Password field
components.description: Gift-page password field with a navy stroke and red focus treatment.
components.html: <label class="ds-password-label" for="ds-password">Password</label><input class="ds-password-input" id="ds-password" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required>
components.css: .ds-password-label { font-weight: 700; } .ds-password-input { width: 100%; min-height: 3.1rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem; color: #2c3e50; font: inherit; border: 2px solid #2c3e50; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; caret-color: #ac2222; } .ds-password-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ac2222; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Gift panel
components.description: Off-white, left-aligned content panel within the centered gift-page layout.
components.html:

The sourdough starter is checking the guest list.
components.css: .ds-gift-panel { width: min(100%, 42rem); padding: clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 2.5rem); color: #2c3e50; text-align: left; background: #e0e0e0; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24); } .ds-gift-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 2rem); line-height: 1.2; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-gift-panel > p { margin: 0 0 1.25rem; font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.5; }

narrative.overview:
LeppäCaasa pages use a centered layout, a navy page background, white text, and the existing Comic Sans/Comic Neue cursive stack. Red actions, pale content panels, rounded controls, and soft shadows recur across the site. The copy and imagery use the household's playful lore around sourdough and cooking, Gabibbo, and fritto misto.

The `/gift/` page carries those styles into its centered panel, form, quiz controls, and sourdough-jar illustration. Creative North Star: Unspecified.

Red actions and pale panels with rounded corners.
Comic Sans/Comic Neue typography and playful household lore.
